scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:chrome && npm run bundle:edge && npm run bundle:firefox
scripts.bundle:chrome: npm run generate:locales && wxt zip -b chrome
scripts.bundle:edge: npm run generate:locales && wxt zip -b edge
scripts.bundle:firefox: npm run generate:locales && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.bundle:safari: npm run generate:locales && wxt zip -b safari
scripts.check-types: npm run generate:locales && wxt prepare && tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm run generate:locales && wxt prepare && eslint src --max-warnings 0
